rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with an expanded/collapsed day-5 blastocyst and thinned zona, but it overstates confidence in identifying an A-grade ICM and cohesive TE from this single somewhat collapsed image.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve/response, tubal factor, semen parameters, endometrium, and cycle history into prognosis and transfer planning.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent overall; probability estimate is plausible, though morphology interpretation is a bit more confident than the image alone supports.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice guidelines, including SET for a good-quality day-5 blastocyst in a 33-year-old and attention to hydrosalpinx; minor overreach in discussing PGT-A/embryo banking without stronger case-specific indication.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, though some advice remains somewhat general rather than tightly protocol-specific.
